mission: Reproducibility Audit, Controlled Arithmetic Learning, and Evidence-Based Next Steps

benchmark_specification.name: ChakrMicro Single-Digit Arithmetic Benchmark v1
benchmark_specification.domain: Single-digit addition a + b = c, with a,b in [0..9], c <= 9

condition_a_uniform_sft_100steps.phenomenon: Constant attractor collapse to median digit '7'. The 1/10 val and test exact matches are instances where the true sum was 7.

condition_c_answer_only_diagnostic.phenomenon: Infinite digit repetition due to complete absence of termination supervision.

overfit_control_3ex_50steps.phenomenon: 100% memorization on small subset confirms optimization and backprop pipelines are fully functional.

batch74_rationale_intermediate_sft.phenomenon: Premise drift and intermediate hallucination. Model outputs syntactically correct explanations ('4 + 0 = 7. Answer: 7') but drifts from the prompt premises, failing to generalize mathematically.

scientific_verdict.memorization: SUPPORTED (100% on 3-ex overfit and up to 100% on 32-ex full-batch).
scientific_verdict.transformation_generalization: CONFIRMED_ZERO (0.0% true operator generalization across direct, weighted, and rationale SFT).
scientific_verdict.root_cause: A 3.44M parameter model trained directly via next-token prediction cannot map 2 arbitrary input integers across 40 attention positions into an answer token in one feedforward pass without pre-existing arithmetic representations or structured routing circuits.
